notes.note: Follows clause example 1 (modified template of a template-list signature template), which is statically detectable, hence reject. Titan accepts it: it does not implement this check.
Titan rejects 'template S s := ?' for signatures; this is allowed by 15.6.4 example 2, so the Titan warning is a Titan limitation.
Same Titan limitation as 15.06.04_test_004 (AnyValue for a whole signature template). Observes AnyValue on par2 by matching two calls with different par2 values.
Same Titan limitation as 15.06.04_test_004 (AnyValue for a whole signature template).
Ambiguity: tests a union template field (record field g2) holding a template list, which is covered by both readings. Runtime error, since template variables are used.
Tests the left-hand side rule of 6.2.15.7 (expansion of an omitted map template, element set present, value assigned); 6.2.15.7 defines no right-hand side rule.
The standard example indexes v_map[0] although the key type is charstring; the test uses the key "id" to keep the type correct.
Titan does not support map types (index notation on maps), so its warning is a Titan limitation. This also applies to 15.06.06_test_009 and _017.
Titan cannot parse map templates containing AnyElementsOrNone '{ *, [k] := v }', which is the syntax of the standard's example 4. This also applies to 15.06.06_test_013 to _016.

Ambiguity: first reading chosen (the map template contains AnyElementsOrNone after the assignment), checked via istemplatekind and matching an extra key. The test does not distinguish one from two AnyElementsOrNone symbols.
MapDef in the BNF takes a plain Identifier, so the address type is declared as a subtype of a map type: 'type TMap address;'.

Restriction reading chosen; per B.1.2.8 b) it applies to matching during a receiving operation, so the test uses receive with a whole-template omit. Titan accepts it: the check is not implemented for omit.
Restriction reading chosen; per B.1.2.4 b) the test uses receive with a whole-template AnyValueOrNone (Titan rejects it as well).
Restriction reading chosen; per B.1.4.2 b) the test uses receive with a whole-template ifpresent. Titan accepts it: the check is not implemented for ifpresent.
